title: Project 1 deterministic retrieval evaluation set
relevance_mapping: Each relevant_sources entry names a TXT file stem under evaluation/corpus. The runner parses and chunks those files with the production parser and chunker, then labels every generated chunk from the named source as relevant. Unanswerable cases have an explicit empty relevant_sources list.

cases.question: Which service code retries requests using exponential backoff?
cases.relevance_note: The runbook names REL-17 and specifies exponential backoff for its failed requests.

cases.question: When retrying, what happens to the initial delay after each failure?
cases.relevance_note: The runbook says the 250 millisecond initial delay doubles after every retry.

cases.question: How many retries are allowed for failed REL-17 requests?
cases.relevance_note: The network guide states the retry limit for the named service.

cases.question: How long before expiration are TLS certificates renewed?
cases.relevance_note: The network guide gives the certificate renewal lead time.

cases.question: What is the company's 2026 annual revenue?
cases.relevance_note: None of the eight corpus documents contains company revenue information.

cases.question: What response procedure is triggered by SEV-1?
cases.relevance_note: The incident runbook defines the immediate paging action for SEV-1.

cases.question: How quickly must an incident be acknowledged?
cases.relevance_note: The incident runbook specifies a five-minute acknowledgement deadline.

cases.question: What should responders preserve before restarting an affected service?
cases.relevance_note: The runbook directs responders to preserve application logs before restart.

cases.question: Who is paged to lead a severity-one incident?
cases.relevance_note: The runbook identifies the on-call incident commander as the lead to page.

cases.question: How frequently is the status page updated during an incident?
cases.relevance_note: The incident runbook sets the status page update interval.

cases.question: Which database system has production backups scheduled?
cases.relevance_note: The maintenance guide specifically names PostgreSQL production backups.

cases.question: How often are production database snapshots created?
cases.relevance_note: The guide says daily backups run nightly and monthly snapshots are retained.

cases.question: At what UTC time do PostgreSQL backups run?
cases.relevance_note: The guide specifies the nightly backup time as 01:30 UTC.

cases.question: When should index vacuum run in relation to bulk imports?
cases.relevance_note: The guide states index vacuum runs after bulk imports.

cases.question: How long are daily snapshots retained?
cases.relevance_note: The database guide sets a 30-day retention period for daily snapshots.

cases.question: Which encryption algorithm protects the database backups?
cases.relevance_note: The database guide states backup timing and retention but names no encryption algorithm.

cases.question: What is the deployment artifact build tag?
cases.relevance_note: The handbook gives BUILD-2026-04 as the release artifact tag.

cases.question: Which deployment strategy switches traffic between environments?
cases.relevance_note: The deployment handbook specifies blue-green switching.

cases.question: Under what condition should a release be rolled back?
cases.relevance_note: The handbook defines a 2% error-rate threshold sustained for five minutes.

cases.question: What must pass in the standby environment before traffic changes?
cases.relevance_note: The deployment guide requires smoke tests before switching traffic.

cases.question: What is the production cluster's cloud provider?
cases.relevance_note: No corpus document identifies a cloud provider.

cases.question: What is the hotel reimbursement limit per night?
cases.relevance_note: The expense policy caps hotel reimbursement at 180 USD per night excluding tax.

cases.question: When are travel receipts due?
cases.relevance_note: The travel policy requires receipt submission within ten business days.

cases.question: Is approval required before an employee books international travel?
cases.relevance_note: The policy requires manager approval before international bookings.

cases.question: Which rail ticket class is eligible for reimbursement?
cases.relevance_note: The policy allows reimbursement for standard-class rail tickets.

cases.question: What does GET /v2/items/{item_id} return?
cases.relevance_note: The inventory manual documents this exact endpoint and its response fields.

cases.question: Which HTTP header should a client honor when rate limited with status 429?
cases.relevance_note: The inventory manual names Retry-After for HTTP 429 rate limits.

cases.question: How are inventory item identifiers formatted?
cases.relevance_note: The manual describes the SKU- prefix followed by eight digits.

cases.question: What command runs the Python project's automated tests?
cases.relevance_note: The onboarding notes provide the pytest command from the repository root.

cases.question: Which secret manager should developers use for production credentials?
cases.relevance_note: The onboarding notes say not to commit secrets but do not identify a secret manager.
